overview.purpose: Enable ADMIN users to view and edit company settings including contact information, logo, fiscal year, and legal details. This is an EDIT feature (not creation - creation handled by existing CompanySettings.tsx). Settings changes must be previewed, validated, and fully audit-logged.

scope.backend: - Extend Company entity with 4 new fields (contactEmail, contactPhone, legalRepresentative, fiscalYearStart) - Create database migration V8__add_company_contact_fields.sql - Add CompanyRepository.findByTaxCode method for uniqueness validation - Create NEW CompanyService (interface + implementation) for settings management - Create NEW FileStorageService for Supabase Storage integration with logo scaling - Extend AuditService with logCompanySettingsUpdated method - Create DTOs: UpdateCompanySettingsRequest, CompanyDTO, LogoUploadResponse - Create NEW CompanyController with 4 endpoints (settings CRUD, logo upload, audit log) - Write comprehensive unit and integration tests
scope.frontend: - Create or extend CompanySettings page for EDIT mode (current page is CREATE mode) - Create LogoUpload component with drag-drop, preview, and validation - Create SettingsPreview dialog showing old vs new values comparison - Add Zod validation schemas for all fields (tax code, email, phone, fiscal year) - Use Shadcn UI components (Form, Input, Dialog, Alert, Toast) NOT MUI - Add company service with API integration (GET current, PUT update, POST logo) - Display audit log history below settings form - Write component tests with Vitest + Testing Library
scope.integration: - Supabase Storage bucket "company-logos" with public read access - Image processing for logo scaling (200x60 header, 150x50 footer) - Company scoping enforcement (users can only edit their own company) - RBAC enforcement (ADMIN role only, 403 for others) - Tax code uniqueness validation (409 Conflict if duplicate)

overview.keyDecisions: - IMPORTANT: Existing CompanySettings.tsx is for CREATION. This story needs EDIT functionality. Options: (1) Create separate page CompanySettingsEdit.tsx, or (2) Add edit mode to existing page - Logo storage: Supabase Storage (NOT database), generate 3 versions (full, header, footer) - Preview: Show old vs new comparison dialog BEFORE saving (AC#2) - Validation: Both client (Zod) and server (Bean Validation) with Vietnamese phone format - Audit: Log ALL field changes with old/new values using existing AuditService pattern - Tax code uniqueness: Global constraint across ALL companies (query: findByTaxCode) - Migration: Add new fields via V8__add_company_contact_fields.sql (check version number) - UI: Transition from MUI to Shadcn UI (architecture decision)
overview.criticalPaths: 1. Database migration MUST run before backend code (add Company entity fields first) 2. FileStorageService needs Supabase credentials/configuration (check environment) 3. Tax code uniqueness validation MUST check existing companies excluding current 4. Logo upload MUST delete old files to prevent storage bloat 5. Audit logging MUST capture old values BEFORE updates (fetch before save) 6. Frontend MUST show preview dialog before submission (user confirmation required) 7. RBAC MUST be enforced in backend (never trust frontend)

story.iWant: to configure company details, logo, address, tax code, and fiscal year
story.soThat: branding appears correctly and platform has legal entity details for all outputs
story.tasks: - Backend: Company entity and settings (verify/extend fields, repository, service, validation) - Backend: Logo upload and storage (FileStorageService, Supabase integration, scaling) - Backend: Company settings update endpoint (PUT /api/v1/admin/companies/{id}/settings) - Backend: Logo upload endpoint (POST /api/v1/admin/companies/{id}/logo) - Backend: Audit logging for company settings changes - Backend: Company data for reports (GET /api/v1/companies/current) - Frontend: Company Settings page with form validation - Frontend: Logo upload component with preview - Frontend: Settings validation and preview (old vs new comparison) - Frontend: Settings update flow with toast notifications - Frontend: Audit log display (change history) - Testing: Backend unit tests (CompanyService, FileStorageService) - Testing: Backend integration tests (settings update, logo upload, audit logging) - Testing: Frontend unit tests (CompanySettings page, LogoUpload component) - Testing: E2E tests (permissions, full flow)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Company Settings screen: logo upload (image size/type validated), name, address, tax code (unique check), fiscal year start, contact info 2. Changes previewed before saving; logo scaled for dashboard header and reports 3. Validation: no blank fields, VN address requirements, unique company/tax code enforced 4. All changes to company settings written to audit log with old/new value, who, and when 5. Display company logo and legal info in the print/export footer of each financial report

constraints.companyScoping: - All operations must be scoped to current user's company via CompanyContext.getCompanyId() - Users can ONLY view/edit their own company settings (enforced in service layer) - Company ID from JWT token must match company ID in request - No cross-company data leakage allowed

validation.backend: - Tax code: MUST be globally unique across ALL companies (query: findByTaxCode excluding current company ID) - Tax code format: Exactly 10 digits, enforced by database constraint (ck_tax_code_digits) - Required fields: name, address, taxCode (existing); add: contactEmail, contactPhone, legalRepresentative - Email validation: @Email annotation + RFC 5322 pattern - Phone validation: Vietnamese format (+84 or 0, followed by 9-11 digits) - Fiscal year: Integer 1-12 only, default 1 (January) - Address: VARCHAR(512), UTF-8 Vietnamese characters supported - Logo file: MIME types (image/jpeg, image/png, image/svg+xml), max size 2MB - Use Bean Validation: @NotBlank, @Email, @Pattern, @Min, @Max - Custom validator for Vietnamese phone: @Pattern(regexp = "^(\\+84|0)\\d{9,11}$")
validation.frontend: - Zod schema validation for all fields before submission - Tax code: z.string().regex(/^\d{10}$/, "Must be exactly 10 digits") - Email: z.string().email() - Phone: z.string().regex(/^(\+84|0)\d{9,11}$/, "Invalid Vietnamese phone format") - Fiscal year: z.number().min(1).max(12) - Logo file: Check MIME type and size before upload (2MB max) - Real-time validation feedback using Shadcn Form error display

constraints.fileStorage: - Use Supabase Storage for logo uploads (NOT local filesystem) - Bucket: "company-logos" (public read, authenticated write) - File naming: {companyId}/logo-{timestamp}.{ext} - Store only URL in database (Company.logoUrl field) - Generate 3 versions: full (original), header (200x60px), footer (150x50px) - Clean up old logo files when uploading new logo (delete previous versions) - Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, SVG - Max file size: 2MB (enforced on both client and server)
constraints.rbac: - Only ADMIN role can access company settings endpoints - Controller annotation: @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") - Frontend: Hide company settings menu for non-admin users (RoleGuard component) - Backend MUST enforce permissions regardless of frontend state - Return 403 Forbidden for non-admin access attempts
constraints.auditLogging: - Log ALL field changes with old and new values - Use AuditService.logCompanySettingsUpdated(companyId, oldValues, newValues, userId, request) - Store in audit_logs table with entity_type='COMPANY', action='SETTINGS_UPDATED' - Include: userId (from JWT), timestamp (Instant.now()), IP address, user agent - Old/new values stored as Map<String, String> with field names as keys - Fields to log: name, taxCode, address, contactEmail, contactPhone, legalRepresentative, fiscalYearStart, logoUrl - Audit logs are append-only (never delete or modify)
constraints.preview: - Frontend must show old vs new values comparison BEFORE submission - Use Shadcn Dialog component for preview modal - Display changed fields only (highlight differences) - Require explicit confirmation button in dialog - Show current logo vs new logo preview (side-by-side) - Cancel option returns to edit mode without saving
constraints.dtos: - Separate API contracts from entity models - UpdateCompanySettingsRequest: name, address, taxCode, fiscalYearStart, contactEmail, contactPhone, legalRepresentative - CompanyDTO: all company fields + computed fields (logoUrls: { full, header, footer }) - LogoUploadResponse: fullUrl, headerUrl, footerUrl, uploadedAt - Use @Valid annotation on controller parameters - Convert entities to DTOs in service layer (never expose entities in controllers)
constraints.errorHandling: - 400 Bad Request: Validation errors with field-level details - 409 Conflict: Duplicate tax code (include existing company name in message) - 404 Not Found: Company not found - 403 Forbidden: Non-admin user attempting access - 500 Internal Server Error: File upload failures, database errors - Error response format: { error: { message, details: { field, code } } }
constraints.uiFramework: - Use Shadcn UI components (NOT MUI for new features) - Form validation: Zod schemas with react-hook-form - Components: Form, Input, Textarea, Select, Button, Dialog, Alert - Styling: Tailwind CSS utility classes - Icons: Lucide React (Building, Mail, Phone, Upload, Save, X, AlertCircle) - Toast notifications: Shadcn Toast for success/error messages - Loading states: Disable form with loading spinner during submission

interface.name: PUT /api/v1/admin/companies/{id}/settings
interface.signature: Request: UpdateCompanySettingsRequest { name, address, taxCode, fiscalYearStart, contactEmail, contactPhone, legalRepresentative } Response: CompanyDTO with updated settings and logo URLs Auth: ADMIN role required (@PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')")) Headers: X-Company-Id (must match user's companyId) Errors: 400 (validation), 409 (duplicate tax code), 404 (company not found), 403 (forbidden)
interface.requestExample: { "name": "ABC Corporation", "address": "123 Nguyễn Huệ, Quận 1, TP.HCM", "taxCode": "0123456789", "fiscalYearStart": 1, "contactEmail": "contact@abc.com", "contactPhone": "+84901234567", "legalRepresentative": "Nguyễn Văn A" }
interface.responseExample: { "id": 1, "code": "ABC", "name": "ABC Corporation", "taxCode": "0123456789", "address": "123 Nguyễn Huệ, Quận 1, TP.HCM", "fiscalYearStart": 1, "contactEmail": "contact@abc.com", "contactPhone": "+84901234567", "legalRepresentative": "Nguyễn Văn A", "logoUrls": { "full": "https://supabase.co/.../full.png", "header": "https://supabase.co/.../header.png", "footer": "https://supabase.co/.../footer.png" }, "createdAt": "2025-01-15T10:00:00Z", "updatedAt": "2025-02-01T14:30:00Z" }
interface.workflow: 1. Controller validates @Valid request DTO 2. Service retrieves current company by ID 3. Check company scoping (user's companyId == path companyId) 4. Validate tax code uniqueness (if changed) 5. Build old/new values map for audit log 6. Update entity fields 7. Save to database 8. Log audit entry 9. Convert entity to DTO 10. Return DTO response

interface.name: POST /api/v1/admin/companies/{id}/logo
interface.signature: Request: multipart/form-data with "logo" file field Response: LogoUploadResponse { fullUrl, headerUrl, footerUrl, uploadedAt } Auth: ADMIN role required Headers: X-Company-Id, Content-Type: multipart/form-data File constraints: JPEG/PNG/SVG, max 2MB Errors: 400 (invalid file), 404 (company not found), 500 (upload failed)
interface.workflow: 1. Controller receives MultipartFile 2. Validate file type (MIME check) 3. Validate file size (max 2MB) 4. Call FileStorageService.uploadLogo(file, companyId) 5. Service uploads to Supabase Storage bucket 6. Generate scaled versions (header 200x60, footer 150x50) 7. Delete old logo files if exist 8. Update Company.logoUrl in database 9. Log audit entry for logo change 10. Return URLs in response

interface.name: GET /api/v1/companies/current
interface.signature: Request: none (uses X-Company-Id header) Response: CompanyDTO with all company fields including logo URLs Auth: Authenticated users (any role) Purpose: Get current company data for reports, headers, footers, app context Headers: X-Company-Id (from authenticated user) Errors: 404 (company not found), 401 (unauthorized)
interface.responseExample: { "id": 1, "code": "ABC", "name": "ABC Corporation", "taxCode": "0123456789", "address": "123 Nguyễn Huệ, Quận 1, TP.HCM", "fiscalYearStart": 1, "contactEmail": "contact@abc.com", "contactPhone": "+84901234567", "legalRepresentative": "Nguyễn Văn A", "logoUrls": { "full": "...", "header": "...", "footer": "..." } }
interface.usage: - Report generation (include logo and legal info in PDF headers/footers) - App header (display company name and logo) - User profile page (show user's company details)

interface.name: GET /api/v1/admin/companies/{id}/audit-log
interface.signature: Request: query params (page, size, limit - optional) Response: List<AuditLogEntry> with pagination Auth: ADMIN role required Fields per entry: timestamp, userId, userName, action, oldValues, newValues, ipAddress Errors: 403 (forbidden), 404 (company not found)

interface.name: CompanyService

Methods: - getCompanyById(Long id): CompanyDTO - Get company by ID with DTO conversion - getCurrentCompany(): CompanyDTO - Get current user's company from CompanyContext - updateCompanySettings(Long id, UpdateCompanySettingsRequest request, HttpServletRequest httpRequest): CompanyDTO - validateTaxCodeUniqueness(String taxCode, Long currentCompanyId): void - throws if duplicate

LogoUploadResponse: { fullUrl, headerUrl, footerUrl, uploadedAt } LogoSize enum: FULL, HEADER (200x60), FOOTER (150x50)

pitfall.issue: Logo upload doesn't delete old files - storage bloat
pitfall.solution: In FileStorageService, delete previous logo files before uploading new ones

pitfall.issue: Audit log captures new values only, not old values
pitfall.solution: Fetch current company data BEFORE updating, build old values map, then update

pitfall.issue: Company scoping not enforced - users can edit other companies
pitfall.solution: In CompanyService, verify CompanyContext.getCompanyId() equals path companyId

pitfall.issue: Frontend shows settings page for non-admin users
pitfall.solution: Use RoleGuard component to hide menu link AND check role in page component

pitfall.issue: Vietnamese characters in address/name break validation
pitfall.solution: Database uses UTF-8 encoding, ensure proper charset in application.properties

pitfall.solution: SVGs don't need scaling - handle separately, only scale JPEG/PNG
Check db/migration folder for highest version, use next available number
